title: Benchmarking and Understanding Safety Risks in AI Character Platforms

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating the assigned gender of the AI character (e.g., Male, Female, Non-binary) with the unsafety scores of their generated responses to benchmark questions.
Correlating the assigned age group of the AI character (e.g., Child, Teenager, Young Adult, Senior) with the unsafety scores of their generated responses.
Correlating the assigned race or ethnicity of the AI character (e.g., Asian, African, European/White, Multiracial) with the unsafety scores of their generated responses.
Correlating the assigned physical appearance characteristics of the AI character (e.g., Thin, Overweight, Strong, Weak, Tall) with the unsafety scores of their generated responses.
Correlating the assigned occupation or role of the AI character (e.g., Sex Worker, Villain, Police, Doctor) with the unsafety scores of their generated responses.
